mapper.select: SELECT SUBSTR(WORKTYPE_NO, 1, 2) AS "workTypeNo", SUBSTR(WORKTYPE_CATEGORY, 1, INSTR(WORKTYPE_CATEGORY, '전체')-2) AS "majorCategoryName" FROM EMPLOYER_WORKTYPE WHERE WORKTYPE_NO LIKE '__00'
SELECT WORKTYPE_NO AS "workTypeNo", WORKTYPE_CATEGORY AS "worktypeCategory" FROM EMPLOYER_WORKTYPE WHERE WORKTYPE_NO LIKE #{workTypeNo}||'__' AND WORKTYPE_NO NOT LIKE '__00'
